text: dsh-emoji-wallet 是面向 DSH Web 会话的余额小部件，在会话页顶栏工具区加入一个钱包按钮。宿主端注册余额查询路由，从 DSH 凭据文件读取 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并请求 DeepSeek 余额接口；客户端点击按钮后显示账户币种、总余额、充值余额、赠送余额及可用状态，气泡可自动关闭。适合希望在 DSH 会话中快速查看 DeepSeek API 余额的用户。使用前需在 DSH 凭据文件中配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

dsh-emoji-wallet adds a wallet button to the DSH Web session header. Clicking it shows DeepSeek balance and availability. The host reads the API key from DSH credentials and requests the balance from DeepSeek.
想在 DSH 会话页面直接查看 DeepSeek API 余额。
有没有办法点一下就看到 DeepSeek 账户还剩多少余额？
I want to see my DeepSeek API balance without leaving my DSH session.
dsh-emoji-wallet 的功能「会话页余额查看」：点击会话顶栏的钱包按钮后查询 DeepSeek 余额，并以气泡展示币种、总额、充值额、赠送额和可用状态；气泡八秒后自动关闭，再次点击也可关闭。
dsh-emoji-wallet 的功能「宿主余额查询」：DSH 宿主提供 /api/wallet/balance 路由，读取凭据文件中的 DeepSeek API 密钥并请求余额接口，再返回余额数据供会话界面展示。
插件使用凭据文件中的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 请求 api.deepseek.com 余额接口。

> A minimal DeepSeek balance wallet for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): one click shows your API balance right in the session header.
>
> DSH 余额小钱包：顶栏一个 💰，点一下就知道 DeepSeek API 还剩多少钱。

dsh-emoji-wallet README · Features / 功能：- 💰 **One-click balance** — a small wallet button in the session header (right side, next to Session log)
- 🔒 **Key never leaves the host** — the browser only ever sees the balance numbers; the API key is read from the harness credentials file (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) on the host
- 🫧 **Semi-transparent bubble** — click to open, click again to close (auto-closes after 8s)
- 🎛️ **No config needed** — reads `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` automatically

dsh-emoji-wallet README · Install / 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-emoji-wallet
```

Restart the harness. A 💰 button appears in the session header, right next to
Session log. Click it to see your balance.

dsh-emoji-wallet README · How it works / 原理：- Host half: `GET /api/wallet/balance` reads `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from
  `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` and queries `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`
- Client half: a slot component in `conversation.session.header.utilities`
  (the same container as Session log), positioned before it with flex
  `order: -1`
